validation_ack.reason: The FY2022 dividend (US$76.0m, one payment of US$0.07664/share) was funded US$20,583,000 from FY2022 profit and US$55,417,000 from retained earnings (Summary of AGMS 15 May 2023, PDF p. 4: https://petrosea.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/PTRO-Ringkasan-Hasil-RUPSLBT_Eng_.pdf). The AR payout ratio 50.30% (AR2025 p. 161, footnote 'based on profit attributable ... in 2022') covers only the FY2022-profit part: 40.924 x 50.30% = 20.585 = the US$20.583m portion. Real, not a data error.

The FY2024 dividend (US$10.0m) was funded US$9,699,000 from FY2024 profit and US$301,000 from retained earnings (Summary of AGMS 21 Apr 2025, PDF p. 4: https://petrosea.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/PTRO_Summary-of-EAGMS-21-Apr-2025.pdf). AR2025 p. 161 prints payout 97.46%, which equals 9.699 / 9.952 (FY2024-profit portion over net profit for the year incl. NCI), so profit attributable x 97.46% = 9.45 vs the US$10.0m total. Stored as printed; the gap is the retained-earnings top-up plus the AR's choice of denominator.

research_notes: COMPANY: PT Petrosea Tbk (IDX: PTRO), Indonesian mining-services contractor (contract mining, engineering-procurement-construction, offshore oil & gas EPCI since 2025, logistics/support services, plus coal sales from its own CEP concession). Head office moved to Wisma Barito Pacific, West Jakarta (FS2025 Note 1). Reporting currency: US dollar (FS in US$ '000); all money values here are USD million; EPS in US$ per share; prices and DPS in rupiah.

OWNERSHIP HISTORY (not the brief's '2023' date): PT Indika Energy Tbk held 69.80% at end-2021 (AR2021 PDF p. 51) and transferred its stake to PT Caraka Reksa Optima (CARA, controlled by Haji Romo Nitiyudo Wachjo per AR2022/AR2023 PDF p. 3) on 28 Jul 2022 (FS2022 Note 1, PDF p. 16). On 7 Nov 2023 CARA signed a CSPA with PT Kreasi Jasa Persada (KJP, 99.98%-owned by PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk / CUAN, Prajogo Pangestu / Barito group) for 342,925,700 shares (34%), completed 16 Feb 2024 (FS2024 Note 27, PDF pp. 97-98). At 31 Dec 2023 CARA held 68.90%; at 31 Dec 2024 KJP 41.52% and CARA 30.21%.

SOURCE ACCESS: every document came directly from petrosea.com (WordPress uploads) with curl and a browser User-Agent, HTTP 200, no bot challenge; Internet Archive not needed. idx.co.id was not used. FY2020 figures are from the audited FY2020 FS reproduced in AR2020 (PDF pp. 239-384) because the standalone Dec-2020 FS is not linked on the IR page; FY2019 levels are that FS's comparative column.

NO OPERATING-PROFIT LINE: the FS profit-or-loss statement has no laba usaha line, so operating_profit is null in every year; gross_profit (optional key) is stored. EBITDA is stored only where the AR states an amount (FY2024 106.22, FY2025 172.63, both in the BoD report); the bond/sukuk documents define the company's 'Adjusted EBITDA' = gross profit - selling & administration + D&A and print only margins for 2022/2023 (26.33% / 18.59%), which were NOT converted to amounts.

FX RATE: the FS give the closing rate only as US$ per Rp1,000 to four decimals (e.g. FY2025 0.0596). fx_usd_idr = 1,000 / printed rate, rounded to whole rupiah, precise to about +/-0.08%. Implied rates: FY2025 16,779; FY2024 16,155; FY2023 15,408; FY2022 15,723; FY2021 14,265; FY2020 14,104; H1-2026 17,857. Not cross-checked against Bank Indonesia's published rates (bi.go.id not consulted); a reviewer may prefer an official BI/JISDOR datum instead of the reciprocal.

STOCK SPLIT 1:10 (ex 3 Jan 2025): per-share figures are stored as printed with share_basis = the date on which they were on that basis. FY2020-FY2024 EPS, shares_out, year_end_price and FY2020-FY2023 DPS are pre-split (Rp50 nominal); FY2025, the FY2024 dividend (declared Apr 2025) and the interim are post-split. FS2024 (published Mar 2025, after the split) did NOT restate EPS (0.0097 on ~1.0bn shares); FS2025 re-presents FY2024 EPS as 0.0010 on the post-split count. AR2025's share table keeps 2024 prices unadjusted (Q4 close 27,625).

TREASURY SHARES: 16,940,500 shares bought back 11 Jun-8 Sep 2020 (US$2.033m) were held to mid-2024 and transferred to the public 15 May-4 Jun 2024 (FS2024 Note 27, PDF p. 98; proceeds US$8.475m). Hence shares_out 991,664,500 for FY2020-FY2023 and 1,008,605,000 (pre-split) at FY2024 end; FY2020 EPS uses a weighted 1,000,591,292 shares.

DIVIDENDS: all declared in USD and paid in rupiah at the BI middle rate of the recording date; dps = rupiah per share from the AR dividend tables, total = USD million as approved by the AGMS. One final payment per year, no interim dividends. FY2021 and FY2025: no dividend (AGMS 21 Apr 2022; AGMS 9 Apr 2026) -> payout_ratio 0. FY2022 and FY2024 dividends were partly funded from retained earnings (see validation_ack). Payment-date inconsistencies inside company documents are noted on each record (the GMS schedule is used).
PAYOUT FY2020: AR2025 restates the FY2020 payout ratio to 24.78% (8.0 / 32.279); AR2021-AR2024 printed 27.09%. The restated value is stored. Reviewer may want to confirm.

RECLASSIFICATIONS / RESTATEMENTS: no restatement of balance-sheet or profit figures was found between consecutive FS (each FS's comparatives match the prior FS). FS2023 re-presented FY2022 operating cash flow (97,247 -> 89,408, sale-and-leaseback proceeds moved to financing); fy.2022.cfo keeps the FS2022 figure. The H1-2026 interim re-presents H1-2025 revenue for the PTKMS discontinued operation (351,110 -> 340,937); revenue_ytd_prior uses the re-presented figure so both interim revenue numbers are continuing operations.

DIVESTMENT 2026 (not a split): Petrosea sold 99.995% of subsidiary PTKMS to SINI (CSPA 15 Apr 2026, deed 30 Jun 2026; H1-2026 FS Note 40). It is shown as a discontinued operation in H1 2026 (profit 7,620 of the 9,170 H1 net profit). FY2025 annual figures still include PTKMS as originally reported. 2025 also saw subsidiary acquisitions (FS2025 Note 39; NCI rose to 44.9) and a large fleet capex programme (PP&E purchases 415.1).

PENDING RIGHTS ISSUE (no ex-date yet, so not in corporate_actions): an EGMS on 23 Nov 2026 is asked to approve a PMHMETD of up to 170,000,000 new shares (max 1.69% of issued capital, nominal Rp5); exercise price and ratio to be set in the prospectus (disclosure 15 Oct 2026: https://petrosea.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PTRO_DOI-PMHMETD_15102026.pdf; EGMS invitation: https://petrosea.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/PTRO_Invitation-EGMS-23-Nov-2026.pdf). Add it to corporate_actions with ratio and price once the prospectus/KSEI schedule is out.

INTERIM: H1 2026 (30 Jun 2026) is the latest published period; no 30 Sep 2026 FS was on petrosea.com (financial-statements page and WordPress media list checked 2026-11-03) and no news of 9M-2026 results was found. Interim profit is boosted by the PTKMS discontinued operation.

TRADING SUSPENSION: IDX suspended PTRO for cooling-down on 3 Oct 2025 (letters Peng-SPT-00292/BEI.WAS/10-2025 and Peng-UPT-00279/BEI.WAS/10-2025) and lifted it from session I of 7 Oct 2025 (AR2025 PDF p. 32) - expect a gap in the daily price series.

OPERATING DATA: production = coal mined for clients under Petrosea's mining-services contracts (AR figures), not Petrosea-owned production; the 2021->2022 drop (31.77 -> 19.23 Mt) reflects the contract portfolio. Overburden volumes are printed in the ARs but have no schema key.

FS2021 page header typo: the continuation page of the FY2021 statement of financial position (PDF p. 7) says 'December, 2021 (UNAUDITED)' although the document carries the independent auditor's report dated 23 Mar 2022 (PDF pp. 2-5) and is listed as 'Audited' on the IR page.
